summary: Tested the new airport terminal card layout (P/E/F/S + GRANDE + DEMANDA bar) on both backend and frontend. Backend (11/11 pytest) returns correct per-terminal buckets {proximos, equipaje, finalizado, siguientes, grande, demand_pct, demand_level} and enriches arrivals with status_tag and is_large. Frontend renders the new layout correctly AFTER clearing the Metro cache — initial UI was serving a stale bundle showing the OLD 'XA - YP' format. Once the cache was cleared and Expo restarted, all 3 terminal cards (Zona T1, Zona T2-T3, Zona T4-T4S) display the 4 P/E/F/S colored counters, the GRANDE badge, the DEMANDA bar with right-aligned BAJA/MEDIA/ALTA/CRÍTICA label + percentage + trend arrow, the 'Baja Media Alta' scale labels, and the centered 'Score: X.X' chip. Backward-compat fields (total_next_30min, score_30min, past_30min, instant_pressure_*) are still returned.

integration_issues.issue: Stale Metro bundle was being served — the old XA-YP layout was rendered instead of the new P/E/F/S layout, even though /app/frontend/app/index.tsx was already updated. Resolved by removing /app/frontend/.metro-cache/cache and /app/frontend/.expo/web then restarting expo via supervisorctl. Main agent should be aware Expo cache may need a clean restart after large UI rewrites.

issues: The 'DEMANDA' label on the left and the 'BAJA/ALTA/etc.' label on the right render visually adjacent ('DEMANDABAJA 19%' appears almost concatenated) because the row uses space-between with no min-gap. Add marginRight to the DEMANDA Text or paddingHorizontal in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line ~8018.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Add horizontal spacing between the 'DEMANDA' label and the BAJA/MEDIA/ALTA/CRITICA right-side label in renderTerminalCard (index.tsx ~8018).
(Optional) Document that Metro/Expo cache must be cleared after large UI rewrites — main agent could add `rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache /app/frontend/.expo/web` to the deploy/restart script.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py lines 296-310 contain DUPLICATE field declarations for proximos/equipaje/finalizado/siguientes/grande/demand_pct/demand_level (declared twice). Pydantic accepts it (last wins) but this is a code-quality bug — remove the duplicate block.

aggregate_demand_buckets() in server.py:1571 correctly counts P (0-30 min future), E (-30 to 0 min past), F (-60 to -30 min past), S (30-90 min future). Edge values (exactly 0, 30, -30, -60) handled with inclusive bounds.
demand_pct mirrors instant_pressure_pct exactly (server.py:2144) — confirmed by test_demand_pct_equals_instant_pressure_pct.
/app/frontend/app/index.tsx is now ~18,000 lines; renderTerminalCard alone is ~300 lines. Strong candidate for extraction into a separate component file.

Frontend flight-status badges (`flight-status-{flight_number}` testIDs) exist in source at line ~8192 but are not rendered in the default collapsed card view — they only appear when the terminal expands to show individual flights. Not a bug, but worth knowing for next testing agent.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all P/E/F/S, GRANDE, DEMANDA, BAJA-MEDIA-ALTA scale, Score chip, trend arrow rendered correctly across T1/T2-T3/T4-T4S; flight-status badges not visually testable because flights list is collapsed by default — code path verified in source)

seed_data_creation: None — used live AENA data (193 flights across terminals).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach the new airport card: open landing page, fill inputs[1]=admin / inputs[2]=admin, click 'Entrar', wait 7s, click 'Calle' dropdown header, click 'Aviones' option, wait ~8s. testIDs are `instant-pressure-T1`, `instant-pressure-T2`, `instant-pressure-T4` (representatives of the 3 terminal groups). Backend pytest: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://tariff-tool.preview.emergentagent.com PYTHONPATH=/app pytest backend/tests/test_terminal_demand.py -v`. IMPORTANT: if the UI ever falls back to the old XA-YP layout, the Metro bundle is stale — run `rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache/cache /app/frontend/.expo/web && sudo supervisorctl restart expo` and wait ~30s.
rca_of_the_issue: Stale Expo Metro bundle was serving an older compiled version of /app/frontend/app/index.tsx where renderTerminalCard still used the old XA-YP layout. Source code (line 7967+) had already been updated to the new P/E/F/S+GRANDE+DEMANDA layout, but Metro's incremental cache (under /app/frontend/.metro-cache/cache and /app/frontend/.expo/web) was not invalidated. Mitigation: clear those two directories and restart the expo supervisor program; after restart and ~30s warmup the new layout renders correctly across all three terminal cards.
